# Introduction

This is a minimal test document to verify PDF link preprocessing works correctly.

## Link Test Cases

### 1. Internal Cross-References (Work in PDF)

These use Quarto's `@sec-` cross-reference system. In PDF, clicking these navigates within the document:

- Link to test parameters intro: @sec-test-parameters-intro
- **Link to calculations appendix**: @sec-parameters

::: {.callout-tip}
**Key insight**: Standard markdown hyperlinks only work in HTML. For PDF output, use `@sec-` cross-references instead.
:::

### 2. External Cross-Site Links (Should Become Absolute URLs)

These links point to files that are NOT in test config but ARE in book config, so they should be rewritten to https://manual.WarOnDisease.org:

- Link to economics chapter: [Economics Analysis](/knowledge/economics/1-pct-treaty-impact.qmd)
- Link to drug development analysis: [Drug Development Cost Analysis](/knowledge/appendix/drug-development-cost-analysis.qmd)
- Link to DFDA analysis: [DFDA Cost Benefit Analysis](/knowledge/appendix/dfda-impact-paper.qmd)

### 3. Absolute URLs (Should Remain Unchanged)

These are already absolute URLs and should not be touched:

- External site: [War on Disease](https://WarOnDisease.org)
- DIH site: [Decentralized Institutes of Health](https://dih.earth)
- GitHub: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mikepsinn)

### 4. Anchor Links (Should Remain Unchanged)

- Jump to section: [Link Test Cases](#link-test-cases)
- Another anchor: [Introduction](#introduction)

### 5. Cross-Reference Format Comparison

| Syntax | Works in HTML | Works in PDF |
|--------|---------------|--------------|
| `@sec-label` cross-reference | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes |
| Standard markdown link | ✅ Yes | ❌ No (becomes file://) |
| `[text](https://...)` absolute URL | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes (opens browser) |

## Conclusion

**To test PDF links:**

1. Run: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/generate-everything-parameters-variables-calculations-references.py`
2. Run: `python scripts/render-quarto.py test --to pdf`
3. Open the generated PDF at `_site/test/test-links.pdf`
4. Click each link and verify behavior:

| Link Type | Expected Result |
|-----------|-----------------|
| `@sec-` cross-references | Navigate within PDF |
| External URLs | Open browser to that site |
| Anchor links (`#section`) | Jump to section in current page |
| Markdown links to .qmd files | **BROKEN** - opens file URL |
